status: CPU row source/backend cache/registry decoder coupling qualified; whole-model integration remains open

ownership.source: Immutable explicit tensor-ID binding, borrows unchanged safetensors index; no GPU handles or model names. Uses quant-registry row format metadata.
ownership.cache: Backend-owned mutable caller-serialized handle; no borrowed leases. Caller owns returned raw planes independently of cache lifetime.
ownership.budget: One allocation includes cache state, LRU/hash metadata, payload, maximum gather staging/hash and miss scratch. Borrowed source/index, caller output, allocator overhead and OS page cache are separate.

behavior.storage: pread-backed row reads, packed U8 weights and F16 scale tensor planes may live in different shards. No whole table read.
behavior.cache: Open-addressing row lookup with backshift deletion and intrusive LRU. Batch hash reuses staged duplicates even after LRU eviction. No hot linked heap allocations.
behavior.failure: Preflight complete ID/output geometry before cache or I/O updates; staged commit leaves both caller planes unchanged on I/O failure. Failed reads never evict or overwrite a cached row. Earlier valid fills in a failed gather may remain.
behavior.stats: Cache hits/misses, staged reuse, evictions, I/O failures, requested logical bundle bytes and host read milliseconds. Counts saturate at UINT64_MAX. Cache-cold does not imply storage/disk-cold.

checks: Synthetic two-shard row source binding, malformed type/ID rejection, exact row boundaries.
1500 variable-size gathers with an independent LRU oracle; hash collisions and evictions.
Single-row LRU with 8 requests: 3 source reads and 5 staged reuses.
Bad late ID and aliased/private buffers reject before observable cache changes.
Failure in the scale-plane read after successful packed-plane read leaves caller output and cache victim intact.
Wrapped malloc/calloc/realloc fault injection rejects source/cache initialization atomically; no linked allocation calls during successful gather.
Actual layer1/14 storage->cache->quant registry->decoder agrees with original Triton raw/BF16 reference at 32KiB and256KiB budgets.
ASan/UBSan/leak checks cover new source/cache, storage, int4 row decoder and callers.
scope_limits: No default model admission or whole Engram forward integration yet.
No GPU row placement/cache/decode candidate, pinned staging, asynchronous read/transfer overlap or phase-specific scheduling yet.
No actual performance parity claim; reported times are host read times under an unspecified OS page-cache state.
Caller must serialize each cache handle; independent handles may borrow the same immutable source.
WASM source list updated; WASM/NEON execution was not available for this new path.

qualification.asan_scope: All new source binding/cache code, storage reader, JSON, platform and int4 row decoder plus test/probe. Unchanged other quant objects are normal build. Allocation wrappers cover linked malloc/calloc/realloc call sites.
qualification.ram_scope: Cache allocation plus metadata/staging/scratch within its configured budget; borrowed index/source, caller output and allocator/OS overhead excluded. Cache-cold does not mean disk-cold.

normal_probe_rss_scope: Entire probe process including borrowed multi-shard index, golden/caller buffers and cache; not the cache budget.
build_notes: Preliminary fixture test indentation warnings were fixed before final clean build.
Initial ASan link required the established explicit system libstdc++13 path; final ASan builds and runs passed with zero warnings.
